title: October 18 2004: David Ortiz's walk-off single in 14th lifts Red Sox in Game 5
book_use: Game 5 reconstruction records Schilling Lowe and Wakefield walking to bullpen in ninth and attributes the move to bullpen catcher Dana LeVangie's 2013 first-person interview with Bill Nowlin; useful staff communication-chain detail, with LeVangie's purpose/effect claims kept retrospective and attributed
